startersHint: A starter sets whether your face shows, where, and whether your voice is recorded. You can change more under More options.
unsupported: This browser cannot record the screen. Phones and tablets cannot, because their browsers do not allow it. Open this page on a computer in Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
micHint: Uses your microphone. Your browser will ask for permission.
face: Show my face in a bubble
faceHint: Uses your camera. Your browser will ask for permission.
mirrorHint: Shows you like a mirror, as you see yourself. Turn off if writing on a board should read the right way.
systemSound: Also record the sound of the screen
systemSoundHint: Records the sound from the tab or screen you share, such as a video or a call. Chrome and Edge only share it for a browser tab or a whole screen on some systems.
qualityHint: 720p makes a smaller file. A screen bigger than the limit is shrunk to fit.
howItWorks: When you tap Start, your browser asks which screen, window or tab to share. Pick it, then switch to it. Recording continues while you are on another window.
preparing: Waiting for you to choose what to share in the browser window...
countdownHint: Switch to the window you are recording now.
whileRecording: To stop, come back to this page and tap Stop and save, or use your browser's Stop sharing button.
screenBlocked: Screen sharing did not start. Choose a screen, window or tab in the browser window, and allow it.
cameraBlocked: The camera could not be used. Allow camera access in your browser, or turn off Show my face in a bubble under More options.
micBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow microphone access in your browser, or turn off Record my voice.
failed: The recording could not be saved. Try a shorter recording, and keep this page open while you record.
mp4Note: Saved as an MP4 file, which plays on most phones and computers.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. To use it in an app that does not accept it, make it smaller with the Video Compressor and Trimmer, which saves an MP4.
nextStep: To cut the start and end, or make the file smaller for WhatsApp or email, open it in the Video Compressor and Trimmer.
notSaved: Your recording is never uploaded. It is kept in memory on this device until you save it, so very long recordings use a lot of memory. Only your options are remembered, not the video.
